instruction: parse_duration() in durations.py never rejects anything: malformed strings quietly turn into some number of seconds, and some valid inputs give the wrong answer. format_duration() gets zero and negative values wrong. tests/test_durations.py fails. Make both functions follow the rules in the module docstring; every malformed string must raise ValueError and no other exception. Keep the names and signatures, change only durations.py, and don't modify the tests.
